title: #183 City or Countryside
prompt: Some people prefer to live in cities, while some people prefer to live in the countryside. Which is better for you? Give your reasons or experience.

promptSegments.text: Some people prefer to live in cities, while some people prefer to live in the countryside.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main point is that city life is better because it offers many shops and services close by.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main point is that city life is better because it offers many shops and services close by.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point is that the country is good for health because the air is clean and there are many trees.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point is that the country is good for health because the air is clean and there are many trees.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Town life is good because it has many shops and services close by.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Town life is good because it has many shops and services close by.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Open land life is good because it has clean air and many trees.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Open land life is good because it has clean air and many trees.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: City living is beneficial because it provides easy access to various shops and services, making daily tasks simpler and more convenient.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: City living is beneficial because it provides easy access to various shops and services, making daily tasks simpler and more convenient.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Conversely, the countryside offers a peaceful environment with cleaner air and a slower pace of life, which is good for mental health.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Conversely, the countryside offers a peaceful environment with cleaner air and a slower pace of life, which is good for mental health.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: City life offers great convenience due to easy access to shops and services, such as universities, saving time and money on transport.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: City life offers great convenience due to easy access to shops and services, such as universities, saving time and money on transport.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The countryside provides a peaceful environment with cleaner air, allowing families to keep pets and grow food, leading to less stress and better quality of life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The countryside provides a peaceful environment with cleaner air, allowing families to keep pets and grow food, leading to less stress and better quality of life.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Compare the benefits of living in a city versus the countryside, highlighting personal preferences and supporting with logical arguments.
outline: Introduction: Present the topic and state personal preference.
Body 1: Discuss the advantages of city living, such as amenities, career opportunities, and vibrant social life.
Body 2: Highlight the benefits of rural life, including tranquility, natural environment, and community bonds.
Conclusion: Summarize the key points and restate the preference.
keyArguments: Cities offer more career opportunities and amenities, making them ideal for personal and professional growth.
The countryside provides a peaceful environment and strong community ties, which are essential for a balanced lifestyle.
